source: Frank H. Grubbs, Frank Bond: Gentleman Sheepherder of Northern New Mexico, 1883-1915 (UNM MBA thesis, 1958)
source_class: Researcher's transcription/reconstruction from company records; original accounts not acquired or reconciled
transcription_method: Manual reading of rendered full pages, checked against table headings and row alignment; OCR not used to assign values to columns
units: Thousands of nominal historical US dollars, as rounded in the source tables
missing_value: null means an ellipsis/not supplied in Grubbs, not zero
comparability_limits: Merchandise gross profit and company net profit are different accounting measures.
Do not sum business-line profits and treat the sum as company net profit; expense and reserve treatment is not reconciled.
Inventory and book accounts are balances, not annual sales.
No inflation adjustment, annual local population denominator, or original-ledger audit has been applied.
A profit for this firm does not measure all Cuervo businesses or the whole town.

table_33.source_caveat: Table footnote flags a conflicting statement about no credit business in Frank Bond's July 8, 1911 letter, Letter Book No. 6. Original letter remains unread.

table_34.zero_note: 1903 sheep investment and 1908 sheep/wool profits are printed as zero; these differ from the source's ellipses.

rows.qualifier: less than; not an exact observation
